scripts.typecheck: for pkg in packages/shared packages/main packages/preload; do echo "--- typechecking $pkg ---" && bun run --cwd $pkg typecheck; done
scripts.build: echo "noop — implemented in a later PR" && exit 0
scripts.clean: find . -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type d -name 'dist' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'node_modules' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
